latest.summary: Based on our Q2 performance and revised outlook for rest of the year, our revenue growth guidance is 1% to 2% YoY. in constant currency terms. Our operating margin guidance remains at 20% to 22% for the year. Large deals were another standout at $5.2 bn for the quarter.
highlights: Based on our Q2 performance and revised outlook for rest of the year, our revenue growth guidance is 1% to 2% YoY. in constant currency terms.
Our operating margin guidance remains at 20% to 22% for the year.
Large deals were another standout at $5.2 bn for the quarter.
One of these mega deals was for over $2 bn with a large international company for a period of seven years, and this is net new.
This deal is expected to contribute over 1% revenue growth in the coming financial year.

willDo: Based on our Q2 performance and revised outlook for rest of the year, our revenue growth guidance is 1% to 2% YoY. in constant currency terms.
Our operating margin guidance remains at 20% to 22% for the year.
willEndure: As you look forward, the next half, which is H2, we will have impact coming from compensation, as you rightly said, so that will have a headwind.
H2 margins will be impacted by compensation hikes, softer revenue seasonality, continued sharing of AI driven productivity benefits and ramp-up of large deals.
As we look forward in the H2, we will have compensation rollout, a large part of that will be effective October and the second phase will be effective January.
strengths: Large deals were another standout at $5.2 bn for the quarter.
weaknesses: We are revising our full year revenue growth guidance to 1% to 2%, reflecting softer-than-expected H1 performance and our updated assessment for the rest of the year.
Q2 operating margins were at 21%, decline of 0.1% sequentially.
Our Q2 has been softer and our volume continues to remain softer.
opportunities: One of these mega deals was for over $2 bn with a large international company for a period of seven years, and this is net new.
The second mega deal was for $1 bn for a renewal.
AI revenue was a standout at 10.5% of our revenue, growing at 29% sequentially.
threats: If you see last many years -- last couple of years, we have been able to maintain our margin at 21% despite all the headwinds while investing in the business, whether it is sales and marketing, whether it is talent…
At the lower end of the guidance, we have baked in higher uncertainty at the upper end of the guidance, we have baked in an improvement in the environment.
And just to clarify the impact of all the headwinds that we see has been baked in, in the guidance.
